app.name: Titra
app.disclaimer: Titra is a logging and reference tool. It does not replace your clinician's judgement or recommend doses. Curves are estimates from population pharmacokinetic models.

setup.title: Configure Supabase
setup.body: Titra needs your Supabase project URL and anon key. Create a .env.local file at the project root with these variables and restart the dev server:
setup.steps: 1. Create a project at supabase.com · 2. Run supabase/migrations/*.sql in the SQL Editor · 3. Copy URL and anon key from Project Settings → API
